seo_title: Cost of Living in Nicosia 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Nicosia per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The business capital of Cyprus with a year-round IT industry and affordable prices compared to Limassol. English everywhere, a transparent tax system and a simplified residence permit procedure for Russians.
pros: English everywhere — a lower language barrier
A simple pink slip procedure for Russians (residence permit in 2 months)
A transparent tax system with benefits for non-residents
A growing IT industry and major offices of JetBrains, EPAM and Wargaming
Close to the sea (40 minutes to Larnaca or Limassol)
cons: Hot, dry summers of +35°C with no sea breeze
Cold nights in winter; heating is weak and expensive
A divided island — there is a northern Turkish part

visa_steps.title: Pink Slip
visa_steps.description: A temporary residence permit for the financially independent: a 24,000 euro deposit in a Cypriot bank and a rental.

visa_steps.title: Trade Office
visa_steps.description: Registering a company or becoming an IT-industry resident — a path to the Yellow Slip and tax residency.

visa_steps.title: Yellow Slip
visa_steps.description: A residence permit for EU citizens and for Russians through employment. Processing takes 1–2 months.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Bank of Cyprus, Hellenic Bank — they open accounts with a residence permit. Proof of source of funds is required.

visa_steps.title: Tax registration
visa_steps.description: Obtaining a TIN and a social number — mandatory for work and applying for social benefits.

faq.question: How is English in Nicosia?
faq.answer: In Nicosia English is the second official language. All services, schools and healthcare are conducted in it.

faq.question: Can I work remotely in Nicosia?
faq.answer: Yes, through registering as a sole trader or a local company. A reduced 12.5% tax with the IP Box.

faq.question: How much does a residence permit cost in Nicosia?
faq.answer: The Pink Slip costs a 24,000 euro deposit + 2,000 euros for processing. A residence permit through employment is free for the employer.

faq.question: Where is the sea in Nicosia?
faq.answer: 40 minutes to Larnaca or 1 hour to Limassol. Many people live in Nicosia and go to the beach on weekends.

faq.question: Is the climate hard in Nicosia?
faq.answer: Very hot, dry summers of +35–40°C and mild winters of +10–15°C. Air conditioning is essential.

faq.question: Are the schools good in Nicosia?
faq.answer: Cyprus American Academy, Junior School, English School — top international schools with tuition from 8,000 euros a year.

reviews.text: I moved through relocation and got tax residency after 2 years. A salary in euros, a 12.5% tax, my daughter at the English School. The downside — 40°C and dry in summer.
We got a Pink Slip for the whole family, my husband works for a Canadian startup. Nicosia is for those who want Cyprus but without the resort noise of Limassol.
